coverage_confidence.basis: The official ServiceNow Table API documents six uniform HTTP operation templates. The table name, fields, ACLs, and customer-defined tables are instance-dependent; this connector pins the six fixed templates and records the dynamic-schema basis rather than inventing a finite instance total.

dynamic_schema_basis.basis: The request template accepts any table_name allowed by the target instance. Its dictionary fields and ACL-permitted data surface cannot be enumerated from the public platform reference.
